method: The fix only removes pixels, never adds them. A skin pixel is dropped when (in this order, each pixel counted under the first rule that drops it): it can never be tinted (alpha <= 127 or L* <= 18, the variant outline policy), it lies inside a garment or prop polygon, its CIELAB colour is nearest to a clothing centre of its look (among clothing, trusted-skin and trusted-hair centres), or it lies outside the frame's skin regions (skin_regions.json). A hair pixel is dropped by the first three rules. Centres per look, over its ten frames: clothing = k-means of the opaque non-outline pixels inside the garment and prop polygons (eroded by one pixel so antialiased skin at a polygon edge does not become a clothing colour); trusted skin = the original skin mask inside the S/idle anatomy face and forearm boxes and the owner skin supports; trusted hair = the original hair mask inside the hair envelopes, outside the hair exclusions and the polygons. A clothing centre closer than skin_guard_delta_e to a trusted-skin centre is dropped (tan hide and skin shadows share colours; there the polygons and the regions decide, not colour); for the hair rule the clothing centres closer than hair_guard_delta_e to a hair centre are also left out (dark fur and dark hair share colours; the source hair envelope decides). Deterministic: integer polygon rasterisation (Pillow, inclusive), k-means on the look's unique colours (Lab rounded to 1e-6) with farthest-point initialisation from the darkest colour and at most kmeans_iterations steps, centres rounded to 1e-6 after every step, PNG written by Pillow with fixed settings (no ancillary chunks). `--check` writes nothing and exits 1 when any committed output differs from a fresh build or a stale file sits in the masks folder.
